items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-07-14
items.q: I never will forget one time, Hip Ginley once said, the prettiest thing about a tune is the tune.

ctx.x: Yeah, we're ready. Yeah. Yeah. I just wanted to say that we've got Pam Tala interviewing Jeff Riddick now, the third reel, so he can answer her question instead of me. You're close enough to the mic, Pam. Okay.

There are 10,000 people, for instance, in a gathering, and I'm playing. And maybe out of that 10,000 people, I may get 20 written requests, or I may not get one. I never know. But I always had the attitude this, that if that was your favorite tune while I was playing it, then it was my favorite tune. And that's the only way that I can give you an answer to it, because I always had that idea. And I never will forget one time, Hip Ginley once said, the prettiest thing about a tune is the tune.
Well, what about you and your wife? Did you all have a favorite song? Favorite songs?
